description: Defines an immutable data class 'MeetingData' representing meeting details, including attendance, clients, and calendar info, with static factory methods for creating and modifying instances.

classes.name: MeetingData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a Meeting, with fields for ID, date, attendance, clients, calendar, and attendance options, including static factory methods.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a MeetingData instance with specified ID and meeting date.

methods.name: withClientsAttendanceAndAttendanceTypeOptions
methods.description: Creates a new MeetingData instance with specified clients attendance and attendance type options, based on an existing MeetingData.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template MeetingData with provided clients, calendar data, and attendance options, with other fields null.

methods.name: withAttendanceTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a new MeetingData instance with updated attendance type options.
